summary: V6.25.29 retest after main-agent fixes. Cypher (Vex Ashenhart) + D&D 5E (Lyra Stormblade) sheet renderers loaded successfully via /app/characters/{id} (NOTE: review request used wrong path /characters/{id} which is a 404 redirect). CypherSheetView renders correctly (sentence, type/descriptor/focus, tier 2, abilities, CypherXPPanel mounts) and SpellTracker is HIDDEN for cypher. DnD chassis (Paladin/Half-Elf/lv3/HP 28), spell-slots panel, and inventory render — SpellTracker is VISIBLE for dnd-5e. BESM Eli Mechanics tab confirms SpellTracker HIDDEN per V6.25.29 fix. HOWEVER: TWO data-shape bugs found — (1) Cypher pools render 0/0/Edge 0 (CypherSheetView reads state.pools["Might"] flat number; seed writes pools.might={max,current,edge} nested+lowercase). (2) DnD spell slots are derived from class progression table and IGNORE seeded folio.dnd_state.spell_slots (Lyra's seeded 4/2 slots not honoured; renders 3/0 from Paladin lv3 RAW table). Encounter Complete modal flow was code-verified (Run/Complete buttons no longer sessionId-gated per EncountersLibrary.jsx:239-252; modal markup present at lines 592-734) but NOT exercised end-to-end in this run due to time budget after sheet bug discovery.

ui_bugs.issue: Cypher pool rings render 0/0 with Edge 0 instead of seeded values (Might 17/17 edge 1, Speed 15/15 edge 1, Intellect 10/10 edge 0). Code reads state.pools?.["Might"] (capitalised, flat number) and state.edge?.["Might"], but Vex's seeded folio.cypher_state.pools shape is {might:{max:17,current:17,edge:1}, speed:{...}, intellect:{...}} (lowercase keys, nested object). Either the view must adopt the nested shape, or the seed/migration must flatten. ALSO state.cyphers_max=2 with state.cyphers=[2 entries] is correct in folio but UI did not surface a 'Cyphers carried 2/2' label anywhere.

Spell slots panel ignores state.spell_slots from folio and instead derives slots purely from the class progression table (HALF_TBL[lvl-1]). For Lyra (Paladin lv3) it renders '1st 3/3' from RAW table; the seeded folio.dnd_state.spell_slots={'1':{max:4,used:0},'2':{max:2,used:0}} is dropped. Used slots are read from state.slot_usage (also missing in seed). Should honour state.spell_slots overrides when present (level→{max,used} shape).

Verified chassis-summary contains correct Paladin/Half-Elf/Soldier/speed-30/skills, AC and HP 28/28 ring rendered. Ability score values themselves (STR 16 etc.) not surfaced via the roll-{abbr} testids — minor UX/testability concern.

critical_code_review_comments: CypherSheetView pool/edge readers (lines 50-67) use capitalised string keys against a lowercase nested data shape — this is a clear contract drift between the seed/builder writer and the view reader.
DndSheetView spell-slots block silently ignores explicit state.spell_slots overrides — this is brittle for homebrew classes, multiclassed casters, and any GM-side tweak.
CharacterSheet.jsx:392 SpellTracker gate `campaign?.system_id === 'dnd-5e'` is correct and was verified to hide on cypher and BESM 4E sheets and show on D&D 5E.

EncountersLibrary.jsx Run button mounting (line 239-244) now guards correctly on `e.status !== 'running' && e.status !== 'completed'` and Complete on `e.status === 'running'` — this is the right state machine, no sessionId dependency.

rca of the issue: Both sheet bugs are data-contract drift between the V6.25.29 seed payload (nested + lowercase) and the V6.10-era sheet view readers (flat + capitalised for Cypher; class-table-derived for DnD). Reproduce: GET /api/characters/7fb9f4341cf741c5a1f16fd42b4764cf — see folio.cypher_state.pools.might.max=17 — then visit /app/characters/7fb9f4341cf741c5a1f16fd42b4764cf — pool ring shows 0/0. Mitigation (recommended in CypherSheetView): const pool = state.pools?.[k] ?? state.pools?.[k.toLowerCase()]; const max = typeof pool === 'object' ? (pool?.max ?? 0) : (pool ?? 0); const cur = typeof pool === 'object' ? (pool?.current ?? max) : (state.current_pools?.[k] ?? max); const edge = typeof pool === 'object' ? (pool?.edge ?? 0) : (state.edge?.[k] ?? 0). Mitigation (DnD): tbl[i] = state.spell_slots?.[String(i+1)]?.max ?? (isFull ? FULL_TBL : HALF_TBL)[lvl-1][i] ?? 0; used[i+1] = state.spell_slots?.[String(i+1)]?.used ?? state.slot_usage?.[i+1] ?? 0.
